description: Canned HTTP responses and the result or error each must produce. See conformance/README.md.

vectors.description: Past ten recipients the results are not in request order (the request listed 2609710001NN for NN = 01..12, with 12345 at index 5). Results keep the response's order; helpers find them by number.
Partial success is a result, not an error.
The gateway's validator sends message as an array of sentences; the SDK joins them with "; ".

http.body_text: {"message":["Expected STRING, got INTEGER 260971234567, at to -> index 0","Expected STRING, got INTEGER 7, at message"],"success":false,"api_reference":"1764184470578998353"}

error.message: Expected STRING, got INTEGER 260971234567, at to -> index 0; Expected STRING, got INTEGER 7, at message

vectors.description: The docs example shows message as a string; both shapes must work.
message_id is always a string in SDK models, even when a JSON number arrives.
One accepted, one rejected: success, not an error. The API's data.accepted and data.rejected counts keep those names in canonical form.
A rejected recipient echoes to and user_reference_id as the request sent them, which may be numbers; models hold them as strings.

error.message: recipients must hold between 1 and 1000 entries

vectors.description: DuplicateReferenceError whose data.message_id names the original message.
In a rare race the original id is null; data is then not present (null counts as absent).
The request was [id1, id1, id2]: the server de-duplicates, so two results come back. The SDK passes them through.

error.message: message_ids must hold between 1 and 100 entries

vectors.description: The current gateway rounds every balance to a whole number.
The docs promise fractional WhatsApp balances: a decimal must parse exactly.
The balance envelope uses status, and has no api_reference.
The gateway's timestamp carries microseconds; keep it as the string received.
Unknown fields at the envelope and the item level are preserved, and an unknown status passes through.
Not JSON: message is SDK text (null here means any non-empty string).
A 2xx without a JSON object is an APIStatusError, never a result.
retry_after is the seconds to the next UTC minute: 60 - (now mod 60).
